summary: Oracle filed a routine Form 8-K furnishing fiscal Q1 FY27 results (quarter ended August 31, 2026) under Item 2.02 and declaring quarterly dividends under Item 8.01: $1.625 per share on 6.50% Series D Mandatory Convertible Preferred and $0.50 per common share. Q1 revenue rose 30% to $19.3 billion, cloud revenue 62% to $11.6 billion, IaaS 121% to $7.4 billion, GAAP EPS $1.56, non-GAAP $1.92, RPO $664 billion. Preferred pays October 15, 2026 to holders of record October 1; common pays October 23, 2026 to holders of record October 9. No special-situation event; watch earnings-driven volatility and cloud growth durability.
